scope: Offline same-state current-localization diagnosis on all original98 internal validation trajectories only; not an online policy score or deployment suggestion.

definitions.frame_index: NPZ row i is zero-based video frame i+1; initialization excluded.
definitions.valid_gt: Finite GT and positive width/height. Nonpositive x/y does not invalidate this diagnostic. Unknown GT excluded from comparison metrics.
definitions.spatial_eligibility: Saved valid mask intersected with original region plus recorded searched region only when extra_executed. Asserted equal to saved valid for every row. Existing spacing/NMS retained through this mask; no extra deduplication or geometry filter.
definitions.availability_source: search_decision consumes original-region candidates only; adding the executed extra candidates does not change its regional availability. Unexecuted proposals remain invalid.
definitions.spatial_action_eligibility: In action verification mode every eligible spatial candidate has a legal regular action. Pause is the same spatial box and is not duplicated in this spatial argmax. No new pause/write rule is simulated.
definitions.quality_normalization: Saved float32 current_quality=sigmoid(quality_logits), directly comparable across original and extra regions; no second sigmoid or per-region rescaling.
definitions.quality_argmax: Largest predicted quality over eligible candidates, first/lower flat index region*5+candidate on an exact tie. No additional threshold or margin. Computed before GT candidate lookup.
definitions.references: C1 keep is stored original_choice in the same full-policy pre-action state; actual is stored choice. Neither comparison is an independent trajectory replay.
definitions.iou: Recorded float64 decoded XYXY converted to XYWH. Actual GT intersection/union, width/height clamped nonnegative and union floor1e-8, matching collector. Selected boxes verified versus TXT within .000501.
definitions.reference_correct_to_not_correct: Reference IoU>=0.5 and comparison IoU<0.5, including intermediate loss.
definitions.reintroduced_event: Valid GT; no eligible original-region proposal has IoU>=.5, but at least one actually observed eligible proposal does. Exact previous22 events reproduced.
definitions.beats_all_others: Best predicted-quality correct candidate strictly exceeds every other eligible candidate, including other correct candidates. Also report superiority over all incorrect candidates and deterministic argmax correctness to expose ties.
definitions.transition_matrix_axes: Rows reference, columns comparison; failed/intermediate/correct order.
definitions.mean_iou_values: Offline current-box means on recorded states, not native metrics or tracking-policy scores.

limits: All candidates/states came from the deployed full-policy trajectory. Future states, memory writes, crops and actions for quality argmax are not generated.
This naive spatial argmax omits action advantage, harm/write-risk penalties, search cost and intervention margin. No replacement policy is proposed or evaluated.
The22-event cohort is selected retrospectively with GT; all-frame risks on previously correct frames remain in the primary results.
Only actually observed candidates are considered. No unexecuted region, new deduplication, normalization, threshold, NN output, model or queue change is introduced.
